caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular brown object, resembling a piece of decorated leather, positioned in the center of a beige background. The rectangle measures 8 and 1/2 inches wide by 12 and 1/2 inches tall, with these dimensions indicated by labeled arrows drawn along the bottom and right sides of the rectangle. The surface of the rectangle is adorned with a symmetrical pattern formed by small, evenly spaced white dots. The arrangement of the dots outlines a central cross, with curving, decorative vine-like shapes radiating from the cross and filling the rest of the rectangle. More white dots trace the outline of the rectangle near the edge. In the bottom right corner of the background, the signature "Geoffrey Holt" is written.
title: Pierced Metal Screen from Confessional
